key_insight: SARLO-80 introduces a large-scale, global SAR-optical dataset designed for physically grounded multimodal learning at 80 cm resolution. Unlike many prior datasets, it preserves native SAR acquisition geometry and complex-valued measurements, making it more suitable for advanced SAR foundation models.
problem_solved: The paper addresses the lack of high-quality, publicly available SAR datasets that are both very-high-resolution and aligned with optical imagery. It tackles the limitations of existing datasets that rely on low-resolution, intensity-only GRD products and lose important SAR signal information.
method: Builds a worldwide SAR-optical dataset at 80 cm resolution for multimodal learning.
Retains complex-valued SAR data and native acquisition geometry instead of converting to simplified intensity-only products.
Pairs SAR with optical imagery to support cross-modal pretraining, evaluation, and physically meaningful representation learning.
impact: This dataset can help researchers train stronger SAR foundation models and improve performance on multimodal remote sensing tasks. It also enables more realistic learning from SAR physics, which is important for robust deployment in Earth observation applications.
